conviction_note: Nothing found that decides this print: the stock is a wet-AMD regulatory/competitive story (NDA guided Q4 2026, interim SOL-R safety in Q4) and Dextenza revenue (~$14m bar) has not moved it; after a -58.6% drawdown driven by competitor events (Sept 28 -20.6% on 15.4M shares, Oct 19 -8.4% on EyePoint's LUCIA miss) with 13% of shares short, I lean very slightly up (p_up 52) on a 7% absolute scale, so +0.28; the per-finding sum (+0.4) agrees in sign and size.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS -$0.35 (Benzinga https://www.benzinga.com/quote/OCUL/earnings-forecasts) / -$0.36 (Earnings Whispers https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/OCUL); revenue ~$14.2-14.3m (Benzinga) vs ~$13.9m (Earnings Whispers). Two sources roughly agree. No company financial guidance exists (Q2 release: 'no formal financial guidance'); the operational guide is NDA submission Q4 2026, interim SOL-R Week-52 safety analysis Q4 2026, SOL-R topline Q1 2028, runway into 2028 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001393434/000110465926089443/tm2621618d1_ex99-1.htm). print_vs_bar is on revenue: Dextenza was flat YoY in Q2 at $13.5m, so a ~$14.1m bar asks for ~5% sequential growth; I expect roughly in line to slightly under.
positioning_check: Short interest 28.76M shares as of the 2026-10-15 settlement, about 13% of 219.6M shares outstanding, 8.1 days to cover on 3.55M ADV (https://massive.com/quote/ocul, read 2026-11-06); ~29.4M at the 2026-09-30 settlement with 7.3 days (same page via search) and 29.9M / 14.2 days at 2026-09-15 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/ocul/short-interest/). Borrow fee listed ~0.4% (curvedtrading), so not hard to borrow. Options: skew_25d is null in the baseline; put/call OI 0.15 (call-heavy); ATM IV 84.8%; event implied move 8.55% but ATM spread is 67% of mid, so indicative only. findings.finding: The Q3 release is the first scheduled update since the September pre-NDA meeting on the AXPAXLI wet-AMD NDA the company guided for Q4 2026 (505(b)(2), SOL-1 Week-52 efficacy plus an interim SOL-R Week-52 safety analysis to be run in Q4 before submission, >300 patients with 1 year exposure); the release can say 'submitted', 'on track by year-end', or slip it, and may carry the first interim SOL-R safety numbers. Market expectation is 'on track Q4 2026'; no submission announcement found as of 2026-11-06.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 3 2026 Q2 print carried a regulatory-timeline change (SOL-R topline pushed to Q1 2028, FDA confirmed SOL-R efficacy not needed for NDA) and the stock rose +2.82%; Feb 2026 SOL-1 positive topline sold off ~23-27% (rttnews), so the name has sold good regulatory news before.
findings.why_not_priced: The outcome is binary-ish and not yet public; if the market expected a slip the stock would carry put demand (P/C OI is 0.15, call-heavy) and analysts would have cut timelines; if it expected a submission already done there would be an announcement. Mostly inside guidance, so sized near 0 with a wide downside tail for a slip.
findings.independence: Pre-NDA meeting completed in September, still on track for Q4 submission (https://eyewire.news/news/ocular-therapeutix-completes-pre-nda-meeting-with-fda-for-axpaxli-in-wet-amd, 2026-09-16). Company notice for the 2026-11-09 call (https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/OCUL/ocular-therapeutix-q3-2026-results-call, 2026-11-02) frames AXPAXLI as the headline topic. Same company as source; no third-party confirmation.

findings.finding: The drawdown into the print is attributable to competitor/class events, not company news: OCUL fell -20.6% on 2026-09-28 (9.65 to 7.66 on 15.4M shares, ~6x ADV), which a German market report attributes to 4D Molecular Therapeutics' 4D-150 Phase 3 data, and -8.4% on 2026-10-19 (6.87 to 6.29 on 8.4M shares), the day EyePoint's TKI DURAVYU missed non-inferiority in LUCIA (-3.7 letters vs aflibercept); OCUL's own SOL-1 showed superiority to aflibercept. This Q3 call is the first quarterly call since the company resumed them, giving management a platform to differentiate axitinib/SOL-1 from the failed vorolanib program.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On EyePoint's first miss (LUGANO, 2026-08-17) OCUL rose +6.3% as analysts called it TKI-class validation for OCUL (webull, https://www.webull.ca/news-detail/15419429415568384); on LUCIA (2026-10-19) it fell -8.4%: the market has read EyePoint both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: The competitive de-rating is priced (stock 6% above the 52w low); what is not priced is whether the call reverses any of it. If the market already gave OCUL credit for EyePoint's failure, the stock would not have fallen on LUCIA day. This is an inference about management messaging, sized small.
findings.independence: LUCIA miss: https://www.optometrytimes.com/view/duravyu-wet-amd-misses-primary-end-point-in-phase-3-lucia-trial (2026-10-20). Daily bars: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/OCUL?range=3mo&interval=1d. The 4DMT attribution rests on one secondary report; I could not find the 4DMT release itself (4DMT guided 4FRONT-1 topline H1 2027).

findings.finding: About 13% of shares outstanding are short (28.76M at 2026-10-15, 8.1 days to cover), with the stock 6% above its 52-week low after a -58.6% drawdown and a call-heavy option book (P/C OI 0.15); a non-negative NDA update into that positioning has a covering mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest was ~26.7-29.9M through June-September 2026 across prints of -0.61% (May) and +2.82% (Aug); no squeeze seen on prior prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public; what it adds is asymmetry if the release is benign. If shorts expected a slip, borrow would be costly (it is ~0.4%), suggesting some of the short is hedging rather than a directional crowd, which is why this is small.
findings.independence: Sept 15 settlement 29.9M / 14.2 days: https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/ocul/short-interest/ (different provider, same FINRA data).

findings.finding: Q2 cash was $598.6m with a $78.8m quarterly net loss and hiring continuing (inducement grants through 2026, latest release 2026-11-06), so Q3 cash should be roughly $510-530m against a runway 'into 2028' that explicitly excludes the full cost of AXPAXLI commercialisation; any runway restatement or launch-spend outlook on the call raises the financing question with the stock near its low.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A September 2025 underwritten offering of 37.9M shares (massive.com 8-K list) hit the stock at the time (tipranks 2025-10-01 'shares tumble amid financial concerns'); no raise since.
findings.why_not_priced: Burn is public; the new information would be a launch-cost outlook. Asked what the money buys: it funds a 2027 launch of a drug with a positive Phase 3, so a raise would be launch funding rather than distress, hence small.
findings.independence: Hiring trail: inducement grant releases 2026 (https://investors.ocutx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ocular-therapeutixtm-reports-inducement-grants-under-nasdaq-4) and a Nov 6 release listed on https://massive.com/quote/ocul.

findings.finding: Dextenza revenue bar of ~$13.9-14.3m asks for ~5% sequential growth on a product that was flat YoY at $13.5m in Q2 and missed badly in Q1 ($10.8m vs $12.7m est.); a small miss is more likely than a beat, but the stock does not trade on this line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 revenue missed by ~15% and the stock moved -0.61% (baseline 2026-05-05); Q2 beat slightly ($13.47m vs $13.2m) and moved +2.82%. The line is not paid.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely irrelevant to the valuation; consensus seems to extrapolate seasonality. If it mattered, the Q1 miss would have moved the stock.
findings.independence: Benzinga consensus $14.2-14.3m (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/OCUL/earnings-forecasts); Q2 actuals from the company 8-K above. Shares the bar sources with the bar field.

findings.finding: Chief Strategy Officer Sanjay Nayak resigned effective 2026-10-16 to become CEO of a private company, with no successor named (8-K item 5.02), ahead of the NDA and launch build; follows an interim CFO since January 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Stock fell -6.9% on 2026-10-16 (7.38 to 6.87) on the day the 8-K was filed.
findings.why_not_priced: Already public and partly priced on the day; the residual is whether the call names a successor or a permanent CFO.
findings.independence: Interim CFO noted on https://massive.com/quote/ocul (8-K summary).

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Similar Form 144 clusters in Aug and Oct 2026 had no visible effect.
findings.why_not_priced: Tiny relative to 2.8M shares ADV; vest-driven, not a view.

findings.finding: AAII reports one analyst downgraded OCUL as of 2026-11-05 with no upgrades in the prior month (unnamed); the stock fell -9.9% on 2026-11-05 (7.14 to 6.43 on 3.1M shares) without a company filing, so the sell side's tone into the print has weakened.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior analyst-action reaction measured on this name in the window.
findings.why_not_priced: The downgrade and the -9.9% day are already in the price; the residual is that a lower bar into the call cuts both ways. Analyst and rationale unverified, so small.

baseline_tension: The baseline carries no skew; the call-heavy option book, a -11.5% 20-day run-up and a 13% short base lean slightly toward an upside reaction, which agrees with my small positive, but the name's history (5 of 7 prints down, the Feb sell-off on positive data) argues the stock sells good news, so p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (inside the guide): the NDA-timeline finding lands inside the company's Q4 2026 guide, so it went from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 5 (inference/proxy): the competitor-driven-drawdown finding is an inference about management messaging, not a company number, so it went from +0.8 to +0.4.
Lesson 7 (positioning): the short is meaningful (13%, 8 days) but borrow is cheap, which suggests part of it is hedging, so it went from +0.8 to +0.6; it also kept the negatives small.
Lesson 1 (reaction function): a 15% Q1 Dextenza miss moved the stock -0.61%, so the revenue finding went from -0.2 to -0.1.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the cash/runway finding was left at -0.3. The money funds a launch, not distress.
